title: Expand: grow a canvas and continue the picture
description: A canvas action: pick a side and how far in the task bar; the canvas grows that way (one undo step, with the new area pre-filled from the edge pixels as a layer) and the picture is continued into the new border with its surroundings in view (FLUX.2 Klein 4B, 4 steps). Added as a new layer. The Canvas view's task bar lists it; open it here to edit the workflow.
